refusal.reason: Baseline and candidate changed the matched-station exam, so their accuracy figures are not a paired comparison.

measurement_defect.cause: The validator ranked otherwise eligible links by assigned volume and preferred a GeoJSON containing only positive-flow links. Changing gateway demand could therefore change the link used to grade that same demand.
measurement_defect.correction: Candidate v4 chooses the exam from full retained-network geometry using name or class agreement, distance, and stable link id before reading assigned volume.
